IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Natural Resources & Marine Waters (originally sponsored by Senators Swecker and Sheldon)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a study of Mazama pocket gophers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to Mazama pocket gophers; creating a new section;and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of fish and wildlife mustconduct a biological status update of the Mazama pocket gopher todetermine if protection or management of the species is still warrantedby the state. (2) By December 1, 2012, and within existing resources, thedepartment of fish and wildlife shall issue a report of findings andrecommendations to the governor and the appropriate committees of thehouse of representatives and senate. The report must be based on thebest available science and include: (a) Data on whether the population of Mazama pocket gophers are indanger of failing, declining, or are vulnerable due to disease,predation, exploitation, or habitat loss or change; (b) An analysis of the historic, current, and future populationtrends of the Mazama pocket gopher; (c) Historic and current habitat trends of the Mazama pocketgopher; p. 1 SSB 5264 (d) Population demographics and their relationship to longtermsustainability of the Mazama pocket gopher; and (e) Historic and current species management activities of theMazama pocket gopher. (3) By December 1, 2012, and within existing resources, thedepartment of fish and wildlife shall write a recovery plan for theMazama pocket gopher if protection or management of the species iswarranted. (4) This section expires January 1, 2013.
